answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in echo and vault lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the zenith graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1351 impostors cost 1457 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
